reviews.text: Really works to flatten down cystic acne bumps. Helps with acne recovery and removal.
reviews.zh: 真係有效令囊腫型痘痘嘅凸起壓平。有助暗瘡修復同消除。

reviews.text: Really good , it has small needles , feel little tickling when you put it in the spot , it will stick good on the skin .
reviews.zh: 真係好好，佢有細細嘅針，貼落去嗰個位會有少少刺痒，佢會好穩固咁黏喺皮膚上。

reviews.text: Purchasing this second time already! I really love it. It shooth my trouble right away when I use it before bed! Not even hurt when I apply. You have to apply it 2-4 times when your trouble is big.
reviews.zh: 已經係第二次買！我真係好鍾意。我晚上瞓覺前用，即刻幫我舒緩痘痘問題！貼嗰陣都唔會痛。如果痘痘比較大，要貼兩至四次。

reviews.text: Very good! For very stubborn pimples, might need a few patches for it to go down.
reviews.zh: 好好！對於好頑固嘅痘痘，可能要貼幾塊先至消退。

reviews.text: it's a good investment if you hate seeing even a tiniest pimple on your face like me
reviews.zh: 如果你同我一樣，連面上一粒細小嘅痘痘都唔想見到，咁呢款係一個好嘅投資。

reviews.text: I feel like this didnt do much. It doesnt stick very well either. Prefer acropass
reviews.zh: 我覺得呢款冇咩效果。亦都唔太黏得穩。我更鍾意 Acropass。

reviews.text: 3.5 stars. Stick well on pimple but not effective as acropass patches
reviews.zh: 3.5 星。貼喺痘痘上幾好貼，但效果唔及 Acropass 貼。

reviews.text: I don’t know if it was me nor properly cleansing or drying my skin, but I feel like I couldn’t get these patches to fully stick to my skin. The outer edges of the patch lifted/didn’t stick to my skin which hasn’t ever happened with other patches I’ve used.
reviews.zh: 我唔知係咪因為我冇好好潔面或者抹乾皮膚，但我覺得呢啲貼唔能夠完全貼實喺皮膚上。貼嘅外圍會翹起／唔貼實皮膚，呢個情況係我用過其他貼從來冇發生過。

note: 以下評價由 Olive Young 顧客撰寫，OUJI 原文引用、只加中文翻譯，冇改動內容，亦冇刪走負評。只顯示我哋有貨嘅色號，同價錢有關嘅評價唔會收錄（兩邊售價唔同）。
